Where the error is:
- Clamp band z ~0.056 (four grid cells at x ±0.0058, y ±0.0129): 19.4% of error energy (5.82+5.04+4.41+4.09). Mean h there is 0.0041-0.0042, about 1.7 elements across the 2.5 mm wall. Hotspots #1, #2, #6 (3.5/3.4/2.7%, vM error ~30%) sit 0.8-1 mm from f20, next to re-entrant edge 40. f2 touching h is 0.00518 because nothing was refined there.
- Junction-height flanks z ~0.0255, x ±0.0174: ~26% (3.78+3.62+3.48+3.36+3.29+3.17+2.59+2.55). Mean h there is 0.0045-0.0054. Hotspots #3, #4, #5 are near f3/f20/f16.
- Requested vs realised sizes were never fixed:
  - f16: 0.0028 requested, touching 0.00455 (1.6x).
  - f19: 0.0032 requested, 0.0045 (1.4x).
  - f20: 0.0036 requested, 0.00397.

The check-point term is dominated by disclosed P1 (-43%, a low-stress 4.2 MPa point just under the clamp). The other points mostly read 0.5-7% low (one hidden point in a low-stress region near a boss reads ~+10%).

Where the DOFs went: f20 (3199 touching elements) plus f23 (2452) make up nearly the whole 3933-element mesh. The group refinements on the two big tube faces turned the wall into a uniform ~0.004 mesh: 23.4k DOFs bought only 31.9% → 18.6%.

Score arithmetic (estimate):
- The playbook scaling error ~N^-0.4 means score ~N^-0.2, so a blanket finer wall LOSES score.
- A 12k-DOF mesh at 22% would score ~0.27. A 15k mesh needs only e < 23% to tie your 0.189.
- Your whole family of meshes (21.9-26.7k DOFs) cannot win. Only DOFs concentrated at the clamp band (edge 40) and the junction rims (edges 8/39, f16/f19), on a coarser base, can.

COMPARE DIFFS: compare(1,2) was 12.7% and compare(2,3) was 10.6%, close to the true 11.3%. Neither mesh is converged in the foot band.
